articles.title: Juice Uses Earth’s Gravity on Its Way to Jupiter
articles.summary: Juice used Earth’s gravity to change its path toward Jupiter and save fuel. Scientists also tested its tools for studying Jupiter’s icy moons.

articles.title: Rare Rain Brings Bright Flowers to Chile’s Atacama Desert
articles.summary: Rare rain linked to a very strong El Niño has brought bright wildflowers to Chile’s Atacama Desert. CONAF says it is the desert’s largest bloom since 1997.

articles.title: Scientists use “empty space” to strengthen superconductivity
articles.summary: A special cavity strengthened superconductivity in NbSe2. In a six-layer device, its critical temperature rose by up to 5.4%.
